clue.text: Referring to Conservative and Green, return to earlier position

parts.note: re is the Latin-derived word for 'about' or 'concerning'
vert is the heraldic name for green

explanation.surface: A politician talks of Tory and Green parties before announcing a U-turn to an old stance.
explanation.definitionFit: To reconvert is to change back to a former belief or state, a return to an earlier position.

clue.text: Loud noise from river paddle

parts.note: R is the map abbreviation for river
an oar is a pole with a blade used to paddle a boat

explanation.surface: A rower's splashing on the river makes a din.
explanation.definitionFit: A roar is a deep loud sound, like a lion's cry or a crowd's shout.

clue.text: Tray, cold, arrives? That is right

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for cold, as on taps
arr. is the timetable abbreviation for arrives
i.e. is the abbreviation for id est, that is

explanation.surface: A cold tray turns up at a café: is that correct?
explanation.definitionFit: A carrier is something for holding and transporting items, as a tray carries cups.

clue.text: Initially noted this high position in series?

indicators.note: initially takes the opening letter of each of the following three words

explanation.surface: Someone observes that a ranking sits high in a sequence.
explanation.definitionFit: Nth means occupying an unspecified place in a sequence, as in the nth term of a series.

clue.text: In Brunei there's offer of choice?

indicators.note: in signals the letters lie within the words Brunei there's

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether the Sultanate of Brunei gives people options.
explanation.definitionFit: Either introduces alternatives, as in 'either tea or coffee', presenting a choice between two.

clue.text: Islander sat up meeting obsession, new

indicators.note: up in a down clue means the word sat is read from bottom to top

parts.note: mania is an obsessive enthusiasm

explanation.surface: An island dweller sat up late with a fresh fixation.
explanation.definitionFit: A Tasmanian is a native of Tasmania, the island state south of mainland Australia.

clue.text: Recording device cheers prier at outset

parts.note: ta is British informal thanks, like cheers

indicators.note: at the outset means only the opening letter of prier is used

explanation.surface: A snooper's bugging gadget greets them with a thank-you.
explanation.definitionFit: A tap is a listening device fitted to a phone line to record calls.

clue.text: After time regular outlay needed for river

indicators.note: after means the outlay comes following the time letter

parts.note: rent is a regular payment for housing

explanation.surface: Over time, regular spending is needed to keep a river going.
explanation.definitionFit: The Trent is a major river of the English Midlands.

clue.text: Senior pupil perfect after slight switch

indicators.note: a slight switch means a couple of letters of perfect change places

explanation.surface: A top student is flawless once a small change is made.
explanation.definitionFit: A prefect is an older pupil given authority over younger ones in a school.

clue.text: Publicises furious golfer's poor stroke

parts.note: airs means broadcasts or makes public
hot can mean angry or furious, as in hot under the collar

explanation.surface: A golfer, livid after a bad shot, makes a public fuss.
explanation.definitionFit: An air shot is a swing that misses the ball entirely, a golfer's embarrassing stroke.

clue.text: Vegetable we had planted in southeast

indicators.note: planted in means set inside the letters for southeast

parts.note: SE is the compass abbreviation for southeast
'd is the contracted form of had, as in we'd

explanation.surface: A gardener recalls the vegetable they grew in the southeast of the country.
explanation.definitionFit: A swede is a root vegetable, known in America as rutabaga.

clue.text: New leads on little battle? That's gossip

indicators.note: leads on points to the leading letter of each word, which is the one replaced
new tells us fresh letters come in at the front of the words

explanation.surface: A small squabble gets fresh front-runners and becomes the talk of the town.
explanation.walkthrough: 'New leads on' changes the leading letter of each word to T, turning the little battle into a rhyming phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: Tittle-tattle is idle chatter about other people, a synonym of gossip.

clue.text: Last word after cricket match, requirement finally for proof

indicators.note: after places the closing word behind the match

parts.note: a Test is an international cricket match
amen is the word said at the end of a prayer

indicators.note: finally picks the closing letter of requirement

explanation.surface: After a cricket match, the final say is what's needed as evidence.
explanation.definitionFit: A testament is something that serves as evidence or proof, as in 'a testament to her skill'.

clue.text: Group of words becomes strained, we hear

indicators.note: we hear signals that the word for strained is sounded rather than spelt

parts.note: frays means becomes worn or strained, as nerves do

explanation.surface: A cluster of words grows tense under pressure.
explanation.definitionFit: A phrase is a small group of words forming a unit within a sentence.

clue.text: Machine permit not dear oddly

indicators.note: oddly takes the first, third, fifth and other odd-placed letters of permit not dear

explanation.surface: A device is allowed because it is not expensive.
explanation.definitionFit: A printer is a machine that puts text or images onto paper.

clue.text: Love it to change colour

indicators.note: to change tells us the letters of love it are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone is so keen on a thing they want it repainted.
explanation.definitionFit: Violet is a bluish-purple colour named after the flower.

clue.text: Country hotel, so exotic

indicators.note: exotic suggests something strange, so the letters of hotel and so are rearranged

explanation.surface: A rural hotel is so unusual.
explanation.definitionFit: Lesotho is a small kingdom entirely surrounded by South Africa.

clue.text: Football Association secures new site for celebration

indicators.note: secures means the association's letters hold the rest inside

parts.note: FA is the abbreviation for the Football Association, English football's governing body

indicators.note: new means the letters of site are put in a fresh order

explanation.surface: English football's authority acquires a new venue for a party.
explanation.definitionFit: A fiesta is a festive holiday or party, from the Spanish word for feast.

clue.text: A solo sit-in — it's organised revealing one opposing partnership

indicators.note: organised indicates the letters are arranged into a new order

explanation.surface: A lone protester stages a sit-in, showing they reject any alliance.
explanation.walkthrough: The fodder is A SOLO SIT-IN plus IT; the 's of it's reads as 'is', a link, so its S is not used.
explanation.definitionFit: An isolationist opposes alliances, especially a country staying out of foreign entanglements.

clue.text: Hate Latin?

definitions.meaning: the word is borrowed directly from Latin, where it means hatred

explanation.definitionFit: Odium is general hatred or disgust, and it is itself a word taken from Latin.

clue.text: Put together using every cardinal point

parts.note: S is the compass abbreviation for south, the first of the four cardinal points used
E is the compass abbreviation for east, one of the cardinal points
W is the compass abbreviation for west, one of the cardinal points
N is the compass abbreviation for north, the last of the cardinal points

explanation.surface: Something was assembled with all four compass directions.
explanation.definitionFit: Sewn means joined with stitches, so stitched or put together.

clue.text: Work stoppage fails to start — transport for child produced

indicators.note: fails to start means the opening letter is lost

parts.note: a strike is a stoppage of work by employees

explanation.surface: A walkout collapses before it begins, and a toddler's ride appears.
explanation.definitionFit: A trike, a tricycle, is a three-wheeled cycle commonly ridden by young children.

clue.text: Pay collecting article in US city

indicators.note: collecting means the payment word gathers the article inside it

parts.note: to settle a bill is to pay it
a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A traveller pays to pick up an item in an American city.
explanation.definitionFit: Seattle is the largest city in Washington state in the American northwest.

clue.text: Rescue vessel starts to apparently recover kayak

indicators.note: starts to takes the opening letter of each of the next three words

explanation.surface: A lifeboat seems to be retrieving a canoe.
explanation.definitionFit: Noah's ark was the vessel that saved his family and the animals from the Flood.

clue.text: Somewhat grimy section of wheel

indicators.note: somewhat means only part of the word grimy is taken

explanation.surface: Part of a wheel is a bit dirty.
explanation.definitionFit: The rim is the outer edge of a wheel on which the tyre sits.

clue.text: Find recording sad

parts.note: a track is a single recording on an album
down means low in spirits, sad

explanation.surface: Someone discovers a melancholy song.
explanation.definitionFit: To track down is to search for and locate someone or something, so to find it.
